items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I found when we were playing in the different bars and I would listen to him play and I'm thinking of how an act would be under that name. That's when I formed the act of Buck and Bubbles.

ctx.x: So he could play piano so well -- he stood up to play, you know. However, we did this. I found when we were playing in the different bars and I would listen to him play and I'm thinking of how an act would be under that name. That's when I formed the act of Buck and Bubbles.
